name: maude
description: Claude Code plugins by Michal Dovrtěl — `design` (canvas-first iteration on HTML/JSX mocks with auto-managed dev server and chained critique), the opt-in `design-video` (reel cuts, footage analysis, video comps, Lottie export) and `flow` (generic agentic workflow loop with second-brain `.ai/` workspace, config-driven enforcement skills, and subagents). Ships the `maude` CLI (with `mdcc` legacy alias) for scaffolding and tooling.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Canvas-first iteration on HTML mocks under <designRoot> (default `.design/`), element selection via Cmd+Click, auto-managed dev server. Daily verbs: /design:edit /design:new /design:rollback /design:screenshot /design:critic /design:browse /design:handoff /design:help. Setup: /design:init /design:setup-ds /design:setup-docs.

plugins.name: design-video
plugins.description: Opt-in video for the design plugin (install design first): /design-video:reel cuts a folder of raw clips into a directed reel, /design-video:video-analyze reads a clip's picture and sound, /design-video:to-lottie exports an animation to one .lottie; skills video-comp, footage-director, footage-keyframes, video-generation. The Maude desktop app's AI chat already includes it.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Generic agentic workflow loop for Claude Code and Codex — 10 commands: /flow:plan (--prd) → /flow:execute (--quick) → /flow:validate (--fast, --security, --a11y, --visual, --review, --scenario) → /flow:done, plus /flow:run (a plan as a goal, opt-in capped Stop hook), /flow:bug-rca, /flow:bug-fix, /flow:release (--changelog), /flow:record-ddr and /flow:init (--context, --map, --kgai). Role agents worker/spike/scout keep contexts small (skill context-budget). Project-agnostic via <project> placeholders + per-repo .ai/workflows.config.json. Use `maude init` to scaffold the .ai/ skeleton.
